title: coelogyne niana
intro: Coelogyne niana, commonly known as the Niana orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the orchid family. This plant is known for its unique properties, which have been traditionally used in medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Coelogyne niana include its antimicrobial and antifungal properties, which make it useful in treating infections and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
